description: hot press machine MH3848X120T from Shang Rui Machinery. table size 2500×1300mm, opening distance 100mm, max pressure 120TDesigned for plywood, veneer and melamine face lamination, this hot press delivers even heat across the platens for consistent bonding and a stable surface finish. Supplied by Shang Rui Machinery with CE certification on core models, technical support and lifetime spare parts availability.

faq.q: What platen size does the Hot Press MH3848X120T have?
faq.a: Each platen measures the rated platen size, sized for common plywood and panel formats.

faq.q: What temperature and pressure can it run at?
faq.a: Maximum pressing pressure is rated and the heating range is room temp to 120C, covering standard veneer and melamine lamination work.

faq.q: Is the heating even across the platen?
faq.a: Yes. Dual inlet and outlet heating pipes are evenly distributed to keep the platen surface at a uniform temperature, which is what keeps the bond consistent.

faq.q: Can this machine be customised for a full production line?
faq.a: Yes. We configure layer count, platen size and pressure to match your board format and output target, and supply the matching hydraulic station.
